$comment: Illustrative MCP tool contract for brain-mcp, reconstructed from the project notes. The consumer is Claude (custom connector). Renaming a tool or changing its args is a contract change.

tools.name: query_knowledge
tools.description: Hybrid search over the indexed vault; maps to titan POST /search.

tools.name: ingest_note
tools.description: Index or re-index a single note; maps to titan POST /ingest/file.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List domains with chunk counts; maps to titan GET /domains.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Find notes semantically related to a query/note; maps to titan POST /find_related.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List indexed notes grouped by file; maps to titan GET /notes.

tools.name: list_stale
tools.description: List notes whose claims may no longer be true, worst first: agent drafts that were never reviewed, notes with no 'geprueft' date at all, then notes checked longer ago than the threshold. Reads the curation fields titan exposes on GET /notes.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Remove a note's chunks from the index; maps to titan DELETE /chunks.
